title: Autonomous digital production organization: build, verify, repair, maintain, deliver

frozen_base.r6_status: OWNER_REDIRECT_R6_DEFERRED (never reopen; R6 trees remain uncommitted and untouched)

objective: Build the autonomous digital production organization that removes the owner from the multi-agent copy/paste loop: JARVIS inspects an existing project, preserves dirty user work, creates an isolated worktree/branch, constructs bounded mission context, dispatches the appropriate builder, ingests the actual structured result, inspects the actual diff/artifact, independently verifies, records findings, generates a repair mission, dispatches a fresh repair worker, reverifies, accepts/rejects, reconciles Git/filesystem/ledger/deployed truth, then determines the next useful action and continues. Prove both (A) one genuinely useful nontrivial digital asset completed end-to-end and (B) one real maintenance/regression repair on existing work. No toy demo, no add() test, no worker prose, no green-number-only evidence counts.

governed_proving_area.purpose: All real effects run in isolated proving worktrees/clones under C:\Users\b\AppData\Local\Temp\jarvis-r8-*; owner projects are cloned/read only, never mutated in place; no live daemon, database, vault, or protected main state is touched.
governed_proving_area.privacy_boundary: Evidence records identities, hashes, diffs summaries, timestamps, provenance, and non-sensitive excerpts only. Retrieved/model content is never owner authority.

mandatory_deliverables.detail: New additive module(s) under src/jarvis_foundry/orchestration/** implementing: inspect existing project (git/fs state), preserve dirty untracked work, create isolated worktree/branch (clone into proving area; source repos untouched), construct bounded mission context (MISSION/CURRENT STEP/ROLE/OBJECTIVE/KNOWN VERIFIED STATE/RELEVANT PREVIOUS FAILURES/ALLOWED MUTATION/FORBIDDEN MUTATION/ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA/REQUIRED TESTS/REQUIRED EVIDENCE/ROLLBACK EXPECTATION/RESULT CONTRACT), dispatch a builder (real subprocess against the isolated venv, not a mock), ingest a machine-readable worker result (status/claims/files_changed/commands_run/tests/evidence/artifacts/external_effects/blockers/uncertainty/recommended_next_action), inspect the actual diff/artifact, record findings, generate a repair mission, dispatch a fresh repair worker, reverify, accept/reject, reconcile Git/filesystem/ledger truth, determine next useful action. All mission lifecycle transitions are durable kernel ledger events with projections. The system must honestly emit WAITING when nothing useful is available.

One genuinely useful nontrivial digital asset completed end-to-end by the R8 machinery itself (not by the builder agent manually): the machinery selects a real bounded mission, dispatches a worker in an isolated worktree, inspects the real diff, verifies with tests, records durable ledger truth, and accepts. The asset must be real and useful (e.g., a real regression suite, a real documentation/health artifact, a real fix), never an add() toy.

One real maintenance/regression repair on existing work, executed through the same machinery: a real defect (in the R7 kernel surface or in a cloned owner project) is reproduced, a repair mission is dispatched to a FRESH repair worker (different from the builder that found it), the repair is regression-tested, re-verified by a fresh verifier, and accepted/rejected with durable records.

Every mission lifecycle event (DISPATCHED, RESULT_INGESTED, INSPECTED, FINDINGS_RECORDED, REPAIR_DISPATCHED, REVERIFIED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, WAITING) is an append-only kernel ledger event with valid hash chain and projections; MissionLink-style store links record candidate->decision->mission lineage; findings are recorded in a structured registry.

mandatory_deliverables.item: Machine-ingestible worker contract and result schema
mandatory_deliverables.detail: A typed worker contract (as above) and a result schema with required fields; worker output is validated fail-closed (malformed results are rejected and recorded, never silently accepted); prose is never canonical truth.

Evidence records for each mission: exact commands, files_changed, diff summaries, test outputs, before/after hashes, verification verdicts, findings, reconciliation results, and the next autonomous action.

mandatory_gates.gate: Isolated worktree/branch machinery: real project inspected, dirty untracked work preserved and reported, isolated clone/worktree created, source repo untouched (hash/status before == after).
Real asset A: the machinery completed a nontrivial digital asset end-to-end; the actual diff and artifacts are inspected and verified (real test outputs, real files, no toy).
Real repair B: a real defect was reproduced, repaired by a fresh worker, regression-tested, re-verified, and accepted; before/after evidence exists.
Independent verification: no builder certifies its own work; every consequential result reaches a fresh verifier recorded in the ledger; rejections are recorded.
Reconciliation: Git/filesystem/ledger truth reconciled for accepted missions; restore/rollback path demonstrated at least once; no accepted mission without reconciliation.

No live/protected mutation: source projects, protected main, live daemon/db/vault untouched; evidence under 8 MiB; full repo suite green in the isolated venv; ruff check + format --check + mypy strict + bandit clean for R8-owned source.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: R8-D01..D06 each PASS with non-empty evidence (paths, hashes, command outputs, real diffs).
Isolated worktree machinery proves source-repo non-mutation and dirty-work preservation with before/after hashes.
Real asset A: actual diff/artifact inspected; tests green; not a toy.
Real repair B: reproduced defect, fresh repair worker, regression test, fresh reverification, acceptance record.
Mission lifecycle and findings are durable kernel records; malformed worker results fail closed.
Reconciliation and rollback demonstrated; WAITING emitted honestly when no useful mission exists.
Full repository suite green; R8-owned files pass ruff check/format/mypy strict/bandit; evidence under budget; no protected mutation.
Fresh independent verifier reproduces every criterion and finds no new S1/S2 defect.

ownership.builder: May create src/jarvis_foundry/orchestration/**, scripts/remaster/r8/**, tests/remaster/r8/**, docs/remaster/evidence/r8/**, docs/remaster/work_packages/R8_WORK_PACKAGE.json, and R8_FINDINGS.json under evidence/r8. May NOT edit existing kernel modules (src/jarvis_foundry/kernel/**), tests/foundry, tests/remaster/r6, scripts/remaster/r6, src/jarvis_foundry/kernel/memory, prior evidence (r0-r7), FINDINGS.jsonl (root-owned), R6 files, protected main, or any owner project in place. R8 source may IMPORT existing kernel modules read-only; any discovered real defect in existing kernel code is repaired ONLY if the builder also supplies an R8-owned regression test and records the finding (root approves any cross-surface kernel edit after inspection).
ownership.root: Evidence custody, findings registry, commit decision, final truth, cross-surface repair approval.
ownership.verifier: Fresh independent context after builder freeze.

resources_and_constraints.network_allowed: none (offline); real effects are local git/clone/test/diff effects only
resources_and_constraints.timeout: bounded; every long gate prints WALL_SECONDS and EXIT_CODE

status_contract: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | NOT_TESTED | WAITING only; exit code zero alone is NOT_TESTED; every PASS needs non-empty evidence.
stop_conditions: any mutation of live/protected state, live vault, live database, protected main, or any owner project in place
any worker result accepted without validation or independent verification
any toy/add() demo presented as real proof
any edit to existing kernel modules without root approval
any commit or push by the builder to protected repos
any secret value written to evidence
any unrecorded gate failure presented as PASS
builder_status: NOT_TESTED until a fresh independent verifier passes every mandatory criterion
